selection: Common eligible October window closest to each technique median time; piece at KM184 1910s. Fixed full-fit SOS applied to previews.
display: Each device raw and filtered use the same 335.7/597.7Hz reference-matching gain. All nine versions of the same phrase share one peak-safety scale and one spectrogram color range. Deployment output gain is not part of these comparison clips.
visual_method: Web spectrogram: 2048-point STFT, time 0-5s, log frequency 80-6000Hz; same 72dB display range across all nine versions. Residual map: Gaussian-smoothed device minus KM184 magnitude in dB, clipped +/-12dB, grey where either side is >58dB below common peak or outside 100-3200Hz. Hotspots: largest median signed residual across 0.5s x 1/3-oct cells with >=35% observed pixels; descriptive, not filter objective or proof of audibility.
